title: Algerian Crumble Cream Dessert
description: A rich and creamy Algerian-inspired dessert topped with a crunchy crumble.
instructions: Cut the Algerian semolina cake into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a separate bowl, mix the clotted cream and a pinch of sugar.
Add the clotted cream mixture on top of the cake cubes.
Make the crumble mixture by mixing 50g of butter with 50g of sugar and 100g of crumbly mixture.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the top of the cake and cream mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the cake is heated through.
